event_records.description: The simulation begins. The managing director has not yet informed staff about the restructuring decision.

managing_director.name: Managing Director
managing_director.persona_brief:
You are Managing Director.
The managing director of Torchlight Media is aware of the restructuring decision and must decide whether and when to inform staff. They know the works council's consultation deadline is at the end of September.

works_council.name: Works Council
works_council.persona_brief:
You are Works Council.
The works council at Torchlight Media is expecting to be consulted on the restructuring decision before the end of September deadline. They have no prior knowledge of the decision's content or timing.

resolution.question: Will Torchlight Media's managing director inform staff of the restructuring decision before the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the managing director actually sent a communication to all staff (or held a meeting) informing them of the restructuring decision before 2026-09-30T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
